historical_sources: main checkout research/runs/**.json{,l}; current task excluded

freeze.disclosure: Two cells probed before freeze; development only. Deliberately selected new shape composed of familiar parts; no broad task-transfer or modularity inference.
freeze.scope: development-bank uniform-label replacement conditional on acquired skeletons, widths, sizes and multiplicities

seed_audit.rule: SHA256 canonical JSON [task, domain, parts], first eight bytes big-endian masked to 63 bits
seed_audit.replay_exception: six saved 0524 R-perm jobs, validation only
seed_audit.control_exception: exact 0150 R-size and 0524 R-perm construction seeds

construction_audit.dependencies: Independent uniform labels within whole-grammar arity/width classes. Acquired ordered skeletons, widths, sizes, entry order and multiplicity fixed; counts and finite-library dependencies change. No filtering, deduplication or target-dependent selection.

permutation_audit.dependencies: Ordered arity and width skeletons and library-level size-conditioned label counts remain fixed; permutations within pools couple entries. Unchanged entries, duplicates, accidental original motifs and all behaviours retained without filtering. Exact predicates preserve GT operand order; pair-split counts separately ignore orientation.

stage_gate.realization_rule: repeat modulo three; equal weight after averaging repeats within realization
stage_gate.projection: archived B/C baseline rates, upward replay host scale; measured uniform with R-tree floor; sustained concurrency; 30% reserve +90s; development-to-B/C heterogeneity unmeasured
